info.title: Home Center 0.13 Intent Planning API
info.description: Authenticated plan-only API for deterministic infrastructure intents. Successful Storage and Virtualization plans include non-reserving provider-neutral placement metadata. This surface does not execute infrastructure mutations.

200.description: Deterministic planned or blocked intent; resource create plans may include home-center.placement.v1 metadata in the create-step input

403.description: Same-origin or administrator authorization requirement failed
